summary: The file consists of a classic ASP page that sets up a web screen named 'GuidelineDocArchive' and includes a shared ASP logic file.
purpose: This file serves as a configuration and entry point for rendering the 'GuidelineDocArchive' screen in a web application, likely to display or manage guideline documents.

workflows.name: Screen Initialization
steps: Set language to VBScript and disable session state.
Enable response buffering and prevent caching by setting expires header.
Include the shared logic from DoScreen.asp for further screen processing.

business_rules: Session state is explicitly disabled for performance or statelessness.
The screen name must be set to 'GuidelineDocArchive' for downstream logic.
conditions: If any logic in the included DoScreen.asp depends on the screen name, it will receive 'GuidelineDocArchive'.
system_behavior: Upon loading, the system prepares the HTTP response buffer and disables session management.
It delegates most behavior to the included DoScreen.asp logic.
content_gaps: No domain entities, fields, validations, or user actors are defined in this file.
Actual workflow and system behavior are defined in the included 'DoScreen.asp', which is not present.
